answer.explanation: The visible events in the window show steady, healthy execution across all four functions. Max memory used is flat (CrudApi 95 MB, Uploader 101 MB, Thumbnailer 111 MB, Compressor about 103-106 MB) and the configured memory sizes are unchanged across the window. The log is truncated after roughly 4,300 further events, so the remainder of the window was not inspected. No tools were available to pull the configuration, IAM, IaC or code history, so those layers could not be checked. Based on the available data, no configuration anomaly is evident.
